situation (example wording): "give me the share of all rape clearances that were prosecution declined in 2025", "what share of murders were cleared by exception in 2025", "what was the share of all rapes that were cleared by exception in the US in 2025", "give me the share of all rape clearances that were prosecution declined in 2025 by state"
what the app does today: Declined ("This isn't available: a state or national sum of several crimes, a breakdown, a change or a ranking").
proposed behavior: For a state or the nation, one year: the share of a crime's clearances (arrest plus the five exceptional types) or of its offenses (not cleared included) that were of one clearance type (cleared by arrest, cleared by exceptional means, or one exceptional type), from the clearance-by-type sums over the agencies that reported (P171). One figure is a sentence ("In the United States in 2025, 9.1% of the rape clearances were prosecution declined, summed over the 12,345 agencies that reported.") with the agencies line; "by state" is a table with a row for each state, in alphabetical order: the share, the clearances (or offenses) it divides, and the agencies reporting. Several years answer with one row per year, each year its own share from that year's sums over the agencies that reported, never pooled into one share; no period named is every year by year (P181) (Jeff 2026-11-22: "Answer, a row per year"; this replaces the earlier decline of several years). "By state" over several years answers too (Jeff 2026-11-22: "a full ranking for each year, stacked, never pooled"): one table State | Year | share, each year its own block with every state in alphabetical order; a state with nothing to divide is a blank row.
exact default or choices offered: The sentence (one year), the table by year (several years, one row a year), or the table by state, the agencies line, then the Source line.
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (through the coordinator): the national and state clearance share by type is built on the clearance-by-type sums.
status: Decided 2026-11-21 (Jeff, through the coordinator); several years answer one row per year, decided 2026-11-22 (Jeff: "Answer, a row per year"); by state over several years answers a full table for each year, decided 2026-11-22 (Jeff, option 1)
